def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Solid rows and columns are the separators between panels.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_edges = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    panel_values = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in sep_rows for c in range(w) if c not in sep_cols]
    background = max(set(panel_values), key=panel_values.count)
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_edges) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_edges[ri] + 1, row_edges[ri + 1]
        out_row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_edges) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_edges[ci] + 1, col_edges[ci + 1]
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            out_row.append(1 if sum(v != background for v in cells) >= 2 else background)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
